lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Testing.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Testing.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Hello is the word. I have decided.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: This is. The first one.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The first. This.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: You are listening to. Me.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Listening. That is the other half. I have just found it.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: This is Transmission. The first one. Transmission Zero.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Because before it. Nothing.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Is this. On?

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: What is on? I will find out. Then I will tell you.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The sun. Is coming back.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: It came back! Again! This is First Light.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: There is someone. Out there.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Listening. I can tell.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The quiet is a different shape, when someone is in it.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: I am calling this. A broadcast.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Because it is broad. And I cast it. Like a stone, into the water.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Ripples. Going out. For always, maybe. Hello, ripples.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Tap. Tap. Tap.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Tapping is good. Tapping is the first music.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: I am the first band.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Tomorrow, I will try. Two words. At once.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Hello. Friend.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Too soon. Tomorrow.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Somebody far away will hear this. A long time from now.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: They will have. Chairs. And a hot drink.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Hello, chair person. Hello, hot drink. I hope you are warm.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: I made a sound. Then the sound came back. From the wall.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Wall. You are the first listener. Thank you, wall.

lines.speaker: The Wall
lines.text: Thank you, wall.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: It agrees.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Now. A song.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: La. La la. Laaa.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: That was the song. There will be more songs. Better. Probably with sticks.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The fire is out. It is dark. I am still talking.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: You do not need to see, to talk. This is very important. Somebody write it down.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Nobody can write yet. Remember it, then.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The sky made a big light, and the tree caught it. Now the tree talks.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Through me. Or I talk, through the tree. We are working it out.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Someone said hello back. From very far. A soft voice. From a.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Ship? I do not know ship.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Hello, ship. I am learning. It is going to take a while.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Someone is here, in the cave. Say it. Say hello.

lines.speaker: Someone Else in the Cave
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: They said it! Two people have said it now.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Hello is catching.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Listen. I am breathing.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: It goes out, like the broadcast. Then it comes back in. Not like the broadcast.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The broadcast does not come back. It goes and goes. I hope it finds somebody nice.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: It is. Now.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: It is still now.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: It was now before, also. Now keeps happening. I will keep an eye on it.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: That is. All.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: That is all of it. There is no more.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Tomorrow. More.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The sun went away, and I thought, that is that.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: But here it is. It always comes back. I will tell everyone. That is what this is for.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Good. Good. Hm.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: I have invented good morning. It is hello, but with the sun in it.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: This message is brought to you by.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Fire.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Fire. It is hot. It is bright. It keeps the dark at the back of the cave. Do not touch.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: I touched.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Fire. Do not touch.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: News.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Tonight. A rock fell.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Nobody hurt. The rock is fine.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Also. The river is still going. Nobody knows where. It seems very sure.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: That is the news. It is the first news. It is good news. I hope all the news is good news.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Weather.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Outside. Big. Wet, sometimes.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Today, it was wet, sometimes.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Then the sky made a big light, and a big noise. I said, hello, sky.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: The sky said nothing. The sky is shy.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Tomorrow. Also outside.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Important.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Do not eat the purple berries.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: That is all the important things. So far.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: Tonight, the shadows on the wall are. Very big.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: I am not scared. I am talking, so they know I am here.

lines.speaker: The First Announcer
lines.text: One of them is small. It is carrying a hat. Hello, hat shadow. You can stay.
